description: Ampeln mit Akustikkennung Standorte Wien is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MA 33 - Wien Leuchtet. Traffic lights with acoustic identifier, Vienna. Coverage: MA 33 - Wien Leuchtet. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic lights with acoustic identifier Locations Vienna" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MA 33 - Wien Leuchtet. Its keywords include Verkehrslichtsignalanlagen, Ampeln, ViennaGIS, Transport, Blindenakustik, Verkehrsleitzentrale. The listing shows 6 download or service links in PNG, KML, JSON, KMZ. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
